ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Which organism in this food chain uses the Sun's energy to produce food/energy?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a food chain from left to right: Sun (sun) → Grass (grass) → Grasshopper (grasshopper) → Mouse (mouse) → Owl (owl), and the arrows indicate the direction of energy transfer. Reasoning: The question asks which organism uses solar energy to make food/energy. Plants are producers and can use solar energy through photosynthesis to make food; animals obtain energy by eating other organisms. Among the organisms in the figure, grass is a plant and directly receives energy from the sun, so the answer is Grass.
